scope: Object types of the scene records (type n of vm-scenes.json): header words (offset and offset_flipped added by 81:903E to DP 2C, offset_2f to DP 2F), parts (graphic index into 96:C3FA, flip, column, row, depth) and collision boxes of 81:84DE (signed start and size per axis). See src/data/object-types.mjs.
